    <section class="slide title-slide grid-bg" id="slide-1">
        <div class="glow-orb glow-orb-1"></div>
        <div class="glow-orb glow-orb-2"></div>
        <div class="slide-content">
            <span class="tagline reveal">arXiv:2504.03553</span>
            <h1 class="reveal">KnowSelf</h1>
            <p class="subtitle reveal">Teaching LLM Agents When to Think, Reflect, or Seek Knowledge</p>
            <div class="accent-line reveal"></div>
            <p class="reveal" style="color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: var(--body-size); max-width: 600px;">
                Enabling agents to autonomously regulate knowledge utilization through situational self-awareness
            </p>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- =========================================
         SLIDE 2: PROBLEM - FLOOD IRRIGATION
         ========================================= -->
    <section class="slide problem-slide grid-bg" id="slide-2">
        <div class="glow-orb glow-orb-1"></div>
        <div class="slide-content">
            <h2 class="reveal">Current Agent Training Uses "Flood Irrigation"</h2>
            <p class="reveal" style="color: var(--text-secondary); max-width: 800px;">
                Existing approaches indiscriminately inject knowledge regardless of situational needs, leading to pattern collapse and high inference costs.
            </p>

            <div class="problem-grid">
                <div class="problem-card imitate reveal">
                    <span class="method-label">Trajectory Imitation</span>
                    <h3>ReAct</h3>
                    <p>Blindsly copies gold trajectories without situational evaluation. Fails on novel inputs.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="problem-card trial reveal">
                    <span class="method-label">Trial-and-Error</span>
                    <h3>Reflexion</h3>
                    <p>Relies on external feedback for every correction. Fragile to feedback quality.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="problem-card knowledge reveal">
                    <span class="method-label">Knowledge-Augmented</span>
                    <h3>KnowAgent, WKM</h3>
                    <p>100% knowledge injection at every step. Wasteful and suboptimal.</p>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="vs-divider reveal">
                <span class="vs-badge">VS</span>
            </div>

            <div class="solution-note reveal">
                <p>Humans possess situational self-awareness — the metacognitive ability to know when we need help.</p>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- =========================================
         SLIDE 3: THREE THINKING MODES
         ========================================= -->
    <section class="slide modes-slide grid-bg" id="slide-3">
        <div class="slide-content">
            <h2 class="reveal">Three Situational Thinking Modes</h2>
            <p class="reveal" style="color: var(--text-secondary); max-width: 700px;">
                KnowSelf identifies three cognitive situations based on the agent's ability at each decision step.
            </p>

            <div class="tree-outcomes">
                <div class="mode-card fast reveal">
                    <div class="mode-icon">⚡</div>
                    <h3>Fast Thinking</h3>
                    <p>Agent directly produces the correct action with minimal deliberation.</p>
                    <span class="token-label">[FAST]</span>
                </div>
                <div class="mode-card slow reveal">
                    <div class="mode-icon">🔄</div>
                    <h3>Slow Thinking</h3>
                    <p>Agent initially produces incorrect action but self-corrects through reflection.</p>
                    <span class="token-label">[REFLECT]</span>
                </div>
                <div class="mode-card knowledge reveal">
                    <div class="mode-icon">📚</div>
                    <h3>Knowledgeable Thinking</h3>
                    <p>Agent cannot produce correct action even after reflection. Must consult external knowledge.</p>
                    <span class="token-label">[KNOW]</span>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="decision-tree reveal">
                <div class="tree-start">🤔 Can agent produce correct action?</div>
                <div class="tree-branch">
                    <div class="tree-question">
                        <span class="tree-yes">Yes</span>
                        <span class="tree-arrow">→</span>
                        <span class="question-text">Correct on first try?</span>
                        <div style="display: flex; gap: 0.5rem;">
                            <span class="tree-yes">Yes</span>
                            <span class="tree-no">No</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                        <span class="tree-no">No</span>
                        <span class="tree-arrow">→</span>
                        <span class="question-text">Reflection helps?</span>
                        <div style="display: flex; gap: 0.5rem;">
                            <span class="tree-yes">Yes</span>
                            <span class="tree-no">No</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- =========================================
         SLIDE 4: KNOWSELF FRAMEWORK
         ========================================= -->
    <section class="slide framework-slide grid-bg" id="slide-4">
        <div class="glow-orb glow-orb-2"></div>
        <div class="slide-content">
            <h2 class="reveal">KnowSelf Framework</h2>
            <p class="reveal" style="color: var(--text-secondary); max-width: 700px;">
                A three-stage pipeline: Data Construction → Two-Stage Training → Self-Aware Inference
            </p>

            <div class="pipeline">
                <div class="pipeline-step reveal">
                    <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem;">
                        <span class="step-number">1</span>
                        <h3>Data Construction</h3>
                    </div>
                    <p>Agent self-explores environments. Heuristic criteria classify each step:</p>
                    <ul style="font-size: var(--small-size); color: var(--text-secondary); margin: 0.5rem 0 0.5rem 1.2rem;">
                        <li>Action matches gold → Fast</li>
                        <li>Reflection fixes it → Slow</li>
                        <li>Neither works → Knowledge</li>
                    </ul>
                    <div class="step-detail">[FAST], [REFLECT], [KNOW] tokens inserted</div>
                </div>

                <div class="pipeline-step reveal">
                    <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem;">
                        <span class="step-number">2</span>
                        <h3>Two-Stage Training</h3>
                    </div>
                    <p>Sequential fine-tuning approach:</p>
                    <ul style="font-size: var(--small-size); color: var(--text-secondary); margin: 0.5rem 0 0.5rem 1.2rem;">
                        <li><strong>SFT</strong> — Supervised fine-tuning for initial self-awareness</li>
                        <li><strong>RPO</strong> — Reward-based Policy Optimization refines token generation</li>
                    </ul>
                    <div class="step-detail">SFT → RPO pipeline</div>
                </div>

                <div class="pipeline-step reveal">
                    <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem;">
                        <span class="step-number">3</span>
                        <h3>Self-Aware Inference</h3>
                    </div>
                    <p>At deployment, special tokens trigger:</p>
                    <ul style="font-size: var(--small-size); color: var(--text-secondary); margin: 0.5rem 0 0.5rem 1.2rem;">
                        <li>Direct action execution</li>
                        <li>Reflection cycle</li>
                        <li>Knowledge base retrieval</li>
                    </ul>
                    <div class="step-detail">Autonomous cognitive resource regulation</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <script>
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.totalSlides = this.slides.length;
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.navDots = document.getElementById('navDots');

                this.init();
            }

            init() {
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();

                // Mark first slide as visible
                this.slides[0].classList.add('visible');
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const options = {
                    root: null,
                    rootMargin: '0px',
                    threshold: 0.5
                };

                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const slideIndex = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            this.currentSlide = slideIndex;
                            this.updateProgress();
                            this.updateNavDots();
                        }
                    });
                }, options);

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    switch(e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowDown':
                        case 'ArrowRight':
                        case ' ':
                        case 'PageDown':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.nextSlide();
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowUp':
                        case 'ArrowLeft':
                        case 'PageUp':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.prevSlide();
                            break;
                        case 'Home':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(0);
                            break;
                        case 'End':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.totalSlides - 1);
                            break;
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                let touchEndY = 0;

                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.changedTouches[0].screenY;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    touchEndY = e.changedTouches[0].screenY;
                    const diff = touchStartY - touchEndY;

                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        if (diff > 0) {
                            this.nextSlide();
                        } else {
                            this.prevSlide();
                        }
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.updateProgress();
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                this.navDots.innerHTML = '';
                for (let i = 0; i < this.totalSlides; i++) {
                    const dot = document.createElement('div');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    this.navDots.appendChild(dot);
                }
            }

            updateProgress() {
                const progress = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.totalSlides) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = progress + '%';
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                const dots = this.navDots.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
                dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }

            nextSlide() {
                if (this.currentSlide < this.totalSlides - 1) {
                    this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                }
            }

            prevSlide() {
                if (this.currentSlide > 0) {
                    this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                }
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }
        }

        // Initialize presentation
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            new SlidePresentation();
        });
    </script>
</body>

    <style>

        .mode-card.knowledge { border-color: var(--accent-blue); }

        .mode-card .mode-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
        }

        .mode-card h3 {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;

        }

        }

        .mode-card .token-label {

            margin-top: 0.5rem;
            padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-family: monospace;
            font-weight: 600;

        .mode-card.fast .token-label {
            background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
            color: var(--accent-green);
        }

        .mode-card.slow .token-label {
            background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15);
            color: var(--accent-orange);
        }

        .mode-card.knowledge .token-label {
            background: rgba(67, 97, 238, 0.15);
            color: var(--accent-blue);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4: KNOWSELF FRAMEWORK
           =========================================== */
        .framework-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .pipeline {

        .pipeline-step {

        .pipeline-step::after {
            content: '→';
            position: absolute;
            right: -0.75rem;

            transform: translateY(-50%);
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);

        .pipeline-step:last-child::after {

        .step-number {

            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;

            height: clamp(24px, 3vw, 32px);

            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .pipeline-step h3 {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .pipeline-step p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
        }

        .pipeline-step .step-detail {

            padding: 0.5rem;
            background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.05);
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            font-family: monospace;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5: QUALITATIVE EXAMPLES
           =========================================== */
        .examples-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .examples-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);

            margin-top: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .example-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 12px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .example-header {
            padding: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        }

        .example-header h3 {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .example-header .task-badge {
            display: inline-block;
            margin-top: 0.25rem;
            padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-family: monospace;
        }

        .example-body {

        .comparison-row {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.75rem;
            margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
        }

        .comparison-row:last-child {
            margin-bottom: 0;
        }

        .model-label {
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: clamp(70px, 12vw, 100px);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            padding-top: 0.1rem;
        }

        .model-label.knowself { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .model-label.fail { color: var(--accent-red); }

        .model-behavior {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .model-behavior.fail {
            color: var(--accent-red);
        }

        .model-behavior.success {
            color: var(--accent-green);
        }

        .reflection-note {
            margin-top: 0.75rem;
            padding: 0.5rem;
            background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.05);
            border-left: 2px solid var(--accent-cyan);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 6: ALFWORLD RESULTS TABLE
           =========================================== */
        .results-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--element-gap);
        }

        .results-table-container {
            overflow-x: auto;
            margin-top: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .results-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            min-width: 800px;
        }

        .results-table th,
        .results-table td {
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.75rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            text-align: center;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        }

        .results-table th {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
        }

        .results-table th.highlight {
            background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.1);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        .results-table td {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .results-table td.highlight {
            background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.08);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .results-table td.know-percent {
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .results-table tr.highlight-row td {
            background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.05);
        }

        .results-table .method-cell {
            text-align: left;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .results-table caption {
            text-align: left;
            padding: 0.5rem;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 7: EFFICIENCY CHART
           =========================================== */
        .efficiency-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .efficiency-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem);
            margin-top: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .chart-container {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
        }

        .chart-container h3 {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .bar-chart {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
        }

        .bar-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.75rem;
        }

        .bar-label {
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: clamp(60px, 10vw, 90px);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: right;
        }

        .bar-track {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(16px, 2.5vw, 24px);
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 4px;
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .bar-fill.knowself { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-cyan), #00cc99); }
        .bar-fill.full-knowledge { background: var(--accent-blue); }
        .bar-fill.baseline { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3); }

        .bar-value {
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: clamp(35px, 6vw, 50px);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .efficiency-highlight {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .efficiency-highlight h3 {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .stat-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: baseline;
            gap: 0.5rem;
        }

        .stat-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .stat-value.small {
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 3vw, 2rem);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .stat-label {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .stat-comparison {
            display: flex;
            gap: 1.5rem;
            margin-top: var(--element-gap);
        }

        .comparison-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
        }

        .comparison-dot {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            border-radius: 50%;
        }

        .comparison-dot.cyan { background: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .comparison-dot.blue { background: var(--accent-blue); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 8: TAKEAWAYS
           =========================================== */
        .takeaways-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .takeaways-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.25rem);
            margin-top: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .takeaway-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            display: flex;
            gap: 1rem;
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        .takeaway-card:nth-child(2) { border-color: var(--accent-green); }
        .takeaway-card:nth-child(3) { border-color: var(--accent-orange); }
        .takeaway-card:nth-child(4) { border-color: var(--accent-magenta); }
        .takeaway-card:nth-child(5) { border-color: var(--accent-blue); }

        .takeaway-number {
            flex-shrink: 0;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            width: clamp(24px, 3vw, 32px);
            height: clamp(24px, 3vw, 32px);
            background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.15);
            border-radius: 50%;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        .takeaway-card:nth-child(2) .takeaway-number {
            background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
            color: var(--accent-green);
        }

        .takeaway-card:nth-child(3) .takeaway-number {
            background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15);
            color: var(--accent-orange);
        }

        .takeaway-card:nth-child(4) .takeaway-number {
            background: rgba(255, 0, 170, 0.15);
            color: var(--accent-magenta);
        }

        .takeaway-card:nth-child(5) .takeaway-number {
            background: rgba(67, 97, 238, 0.15);
            color: var(--accent-blue);
        }

        .takeaway-text h3 {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
        }

        .takeaway-text p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
        }

        .closing-slide {
            text-align: center;
        }

        .closing-slide .slide-content {
            align-items: center;
        }

        .closing-quote {
            max-width: 700px;
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 3vw, 2rem);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.4;
            font-style: italic;
        }

        .closing-quote::before {
            content: '"';
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        .closing-quote::after {
            content: '"';
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           RESPONSIVE BREAKPOINTS
           =========================================== */
        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.3rem, 4vw, 2rem);
            }
            .nav-dots { display: none; }
        }

        @media (max-width: 900px) {
            .problem-grid,
            .examples-grid,
            .efficiency-grid,
            .takeaways-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
            .pipeline {
                flex-direction: column;
            }
            .pipeline-step::after {
                content: '↓';
                right: 50%;
                top: auto;
                bottom: -0.75rem;
                transform: translateX(50%);
            }
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <!-- Progress Bar -->
    <div class="progress-bar" id="progressBar"></div>

    <!-- Navigation Dots -->
    <nav class="nav-dots" id="navDots"></nav>

    <!-- =========================================
         SLIDE 1: TITLE
         ========================================= -->
    <section class="slide title-slide grid-bg" id="slide-1">
        <div class="glow-orb glow-orb-1"></div>
        <div class="glow-orb glow-orb-2"></div>
        <div class="slide-content">
            <span class="tagline reveal">arXiv:2504.03553</span>
            <h1 class="reveal">KnowSelf</h1>
            <p class="subtitle reveal">Teaching LLM Agents When to Think, Reflect, or Seek Knowledge</p>
            <div class="accent-line reveal"></div>
            <p class="reveal" style="color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: var(--body-size); max-width: 600px;">
                Enabling agents to autonomously regulate knowledge utilization through situational self-awareness
            </p>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- =========================================
         SLIDE 2: PROBLEM - FLOOD IRRIGATION
         ========================================= -->
    <section class="slide problem-slide grid-bg" id="slide-2">
        <div class="glow-orb glow-orb-1"></div>
        <div class="slide-content">
            <h2 class="reveal">Current Agent Training Uses "Flood Irrigation"</h2>
            <p class="reveal" style="color: var(--text-secondary); max-width: 800px;">
                Existing approaches indiscriminately inject knowledge regardless of situational needs, leading to pattern collapse and high inference costs.
            </p>

            <div class="problem-grid">
                <div class="problem-card imitate reveal">
                    <span class="method-label">Trajectory Imitation</span>
                    <h3>ReAct</h3>
                    <p>Blindsly copies gold trajectories without situational evaluation. Fails on novel inputs.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="problem-card trial reveal">
                    <span class="method-label">Trial-and-Error</span>
                    <h3>Reflexion</h3>
                    <p>Relies on external feedback for every correction. Fragile to feedback quality.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="problem-card knowledge reveal">
                    <span class="method-label">Knowledge-Augmented</span>
                    <h3>KnowAgent, WKM</h3>
                    <p>100% knowledge injection at every step. Wasteful and suboptimal.</p>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="vs-divider reveal">
                <span class="vs-badge">VS</span>
            </div>

            <div class="solution-note reveal">
                <p>Humans possess situational self-awareness — the metacognitive ability to know when we need help.</p>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- =========================================
         SLIDE 3: THREE THINKING MODES
         ========================================= -->
    <section class="slide modes-slide grid-bg" id="slide-3">
        <div class="slide-content">
            <h2 class="reveal">Three Situational Thinking Modes</h2>
            <p class="reveal" style="color: var(--text-secondary); max-width: 700px;">
                KnowSelf identifies three cognitive situations based on the agent's ability at each decision step.
            </p>

            <div class="tree-outcomes">
                <div class="mode-card fast reveal">
                    <div class="mode-icon">⚡</div>
                    <h3>Fast Thinking</h3>
                    <p>Agent directly produces the correct action with minimal deliberation.</p>
                    <span class="token-label">[FAST]</span>
                </div>
                <div class="mode-card slow reveal">
                    <div class="mode-icon">🔄</div>
                    <h3>Slow Thinking</h3>
                    <p>Agent initially produces incorrect action but self-corrects through reflection.</p>
                    <span class="token-label">[REFLECT]</span>
                </div>
                <div class="mode-card knowledge reveal">
                    <div class="mode-icon">📚</div>
                    <h3>Knowledgeable Thinking</h3>
                    <p>Agent cannot produce correct action even after reflection. Must consult external knowledge.</p>
                    <span class="token-label">[KNOW]</span>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="decision-tree reveal">
                <div class="tree-start">🤔 Can agent produce correct action?</div>
                <div class="tree-branch">
                    <div class="tree-question">
                        <span class="tree-yes">Yes</span>
                        <span class="tree-arrow">→</span>
                        <span class="question-text">Correct on first try?</span>
                        <div style="display: flex; gap: 0.5rem;">
                            <span class="tree-yes">Yes</span>
                            <span class="tree-no">No</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="tree-question">
                        <span class="tree-no">No</span>
                        <span class="tree-arrow">→</span>
                        <span class="question-text">Reflection helps?</span>
                        <div style="display: flex; gap: 0.5rem;">
                            <span class="tree-yes">Yes</span>
                            <span class="tree-no">No</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- =========================================
         SLIDE 4: KNOWSELF FRAMEWORK
         ========================================= -->
    <section class="slide framework-slide grid-bg" id="slide-4">
        <div class="glow-orb glow-orb-2"></div>
        <div class="slide-content">
            <h2 class="reveal">KnowSelf Framework</h2>
            <p class="reveal" style="color: var(--text-secondary); max-width: 700px;">
                A three-stage pipeline: Data Construction → Two-Stage Training → Self-Aware Inference
            </p>

            <div class="pipeline">
                <div class="pipeline-step reveal">
                    <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem;">
                        <span class="step-number">1</span>
                        <h3>Data Construction</h3>
                    </div>
                    <p>Agent self-explores environments. Heuristic criteria classify each step:</p>
                    <ul style="font-size: var(--small-size); color: var(--text-secondary); margin: 0.5rem 0 0.5rem 1.2rem;">
                        <li>Action matches gold → Fast</li>
                        <li>Reflection fixes it → Slow</li>
                        <li>Neither works → Knowledge</li>
                    </ul>
                    <div class="step-detail">[FAST], [REFLECT], [KNOW] tokens inserted</div>
                </div>

                <div class="pipeline-step reveal">
                    <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem;">
                        <span class="step-number">2</span>
                        <h3>Two-Stage Training</h3>
                    </div>
                    <p>Sequential fine-tuning approach:</p>
                    <ul style="font-size: var(--small-size); color: var(--text-secondary); margin: 0.5rem 0 0.5rem 1.2rem;">
                        <li><strong>SFT</strong> — Supervised fine-tuning for initial self-awareness</li>
                        <li><strong>RPO</strong> — Reward-based Policy Optimization refines token generation</li>
                    </ul>
                    <div class="step-detail">SFT → RPO pipeline</div>
                </div>

                <div class="pipeline-step reveal">
                    <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem;">
                        <span class="step-number">3</span>
                        <h3>Self-Aware Inference</h3>
                    </div>
                    <p>At deployment, special tokens trigger:</p>
                    <ul style="font-size: var(--small-size); color: var(--text-secondary); margin: 0.5rem 0 0.5rem 1.2rem;">
                        <li>Direct action execution</li>
                        <li>Reflection cycle</li>
                        <li>Knowledge base retrieval</li>
                    </ul>
                    <div class="step-detail">Autonomous cognitive resource regulation</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- =========================================
         SLIDE 5: QUALITATIVE EXAMPLES
         ========================================= -->
    <section class="slide examples-slide grid-bg" id="slide-5">
        <div class="slide-content">
            <h2 class="reveal">KnowSelf Correctly Handles Tasks Where Baselines Fail</h2>
            <p class="reveal" style="color: var(--text-secondary); max-width: 700px;">
                Qualitative comparisons on ALFWorld tasks demonstrate KnowSelf's situational reasoning.
            </p>

            <div class="examples-grid">
                <div class="example-card reveal">
                    <div class="example-header">
                        <h3>Task: Put a hot mug in cabinet</h3>
                        <span class="task-badge">Heat + Put</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="example-body">
                        <div class="comparison-row">
                            <span class="model-label fail">OpenAI-O1</span>
                            <span class="model-behavior fail">Incorrectly tries to take an egg from the microwave after opening it.</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="comparison-row">
                            <span class="model-label knowself">KnowSelf</span>
                            <span class="model-behavior success">Uses [REFLECT] token to realize it should heat the mug using the open microwave first.</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="reflection-note">
                            <strong>Key:</strong> KnowSelf's reflection mechanism enables multi-step planning correction.
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="example-card reveal">
                    <div class="example-header">
                        <h3>Task: Put a saltshaker in drawer</h3>
                        <span class="task-badge">Put + Place</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="example-body">
                        <div class="comparison-row">
                            <span class="model-label fail">DeepSeek-R1</span>
                            <span class="model-behavior fail">Reflects that drawer is open, tries to close it first (fails on this interpretation).</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="comparison-row">
                            <span class="model-label knowself">KnowSelf</span>
                            <span class="model-behavior success">Applies [KNOW] token to place the object without removing unrelated items.</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="reflection-note">
                            <strong>Key:</strong> Knowledge tokens prevent unnecessary intermediate actions.
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- =========================================

    <script>
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.totalSlides = this.slides.length;
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.navDots = document.getElementById('navDots');

                this.init();
            }

            init() {
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();

                // Mark first slide as visible
                this.slides[0].classList.add('visible');
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const options = {
                    root: null,
                    rootMargin: '0px',
                    threshold: 0.5
                };

                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const slideIndex = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            this.currentSlide = slideIndex;
                            this.updateProgress();
                            this.updateNavDots();
                        }
                    });
                }, options);

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    switch(e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowDown':
                        case 'ArrowRight':
                        case ' ':
                        case 'PageDown':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.nextSlide();
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowUp':
                        case 'ArrowLeft':
                        case 'PageUp':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.prevSlide();
                            break;
                        case 'Home':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(0);
                            break;
                        case 'End':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.totalSlides - 1);
                            break;
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                let touchEndY = 0;

                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.changedTouches[0].screenY;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    touchEndY = e.changedTouches[0].screenY;
                    const diff = touchStartY - touchEndY;

                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        if (diff > 0) {
                            this.nextSlide();
                        } else {
                            this.prevSlide();
                        }
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.updateProgress();
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                this.navDots.innerHTML = '';
                for (let i = 0; i < this.totalSlides; i++) {
                    const dot = document.createElement('div');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    this.navDots.appendChild(dot);
                }
            }

            updateProgress() {
                const progress = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.totalSlides) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = progress + '%';
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                const dots = this.navDots.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
                dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }

            nextSlide() {
                if (this.currentSlide < this.totalSlides - 1) {
                    this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                }
            }

            prevSlide() {
                if (this.currentSlide > 0) {
                    this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                }
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }
        }

        // Initialize presentation
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            new SlidePresentation();
        });
    </script>
</body>

        }

        .nav-dot:hover {
            background: var(--accent-cyan);
            transform: scale(1.2);
        }

        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-cyan), var(--accent-magenta));
            z-index: 101;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           TYPOGRAPHY
           =========================================== */
        h1 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--title-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.1;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }

        h2 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            line-height: 1.2;
            margin-bottom: var(--content-gap);
        }

        h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            line-height: 1.3;
        }

        p, li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .subtitle {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 400;
        }

        .tagline {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            font-weight: 500;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1: TITLE SLIDE
           =========================================== */
        .title-slide {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bg-primary) 0%, #0d1a2d 50%, var(--bg-primary) 100%);
            text-align: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .title-slide .slide-content {
            align-items: center;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .title-slide .accent-line {
            width: clamp(60px, 10vw, 120px);
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-cyan), var(--accent-magenta));
            margin: var(--content-gap) 0;
        }

        .title-slide .arxiv-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
            background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.1);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.3);
            border-radius: 100px;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            margin-top: var(--content-gap);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2: PROBLEM - FLOOD IRRIGATION
           =========================================== */
        .problem-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .problem-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            margin-top: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .problem-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .problem-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 3px;
        }

        .problem-card.imitate::before { background: var(--accent-red); }
        .problem-card.trial::before { background: var(--accent-orange); }
        .problem-card.knowledge::before { background: var(--accent-blue); }

        .problem-card h3 {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .problem-card p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
        }

        .problem-card .method-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
        }

        .vs-divider {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            margin: var(--content-gap) 0;
        }

        .vs-badge {
            padding: 0.5rem 1.5rem;
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 2px solid var(--accent-cyan);
            border-radius: 100px;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .solution-note {
            text-align: center;
            padding: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.05);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.2);
            border-radius: 8px;
            margin-top: var(--element-gap);
        }

        .solution-note p {
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3: THREE THINKING MODES (DECISION TREE)
           =========================================== */
        .modes-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--element-gap);
        }

        .decision-tree {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            margin-top: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .tree-start {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 2px solid var(--accent-cyan);
            border-radius: 100px;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .tree-branch {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem);
        }

        .tree-question {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem) clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            border-radius: 8px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .tree-question .question-text {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .tree-arrow {
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .tree-yes, .tree-no {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
            border-radius: 100px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .tree-yes {
            background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2);
            color: var(--accent-green);
        }

        .tree-no {
            background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2);
            color: var(--accent-red);
        }

        .tree-outcomes {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 1000px;
        }

        .mode-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            border-top: 3px solid;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .mode-card.fast { border-color: var(--accent-green); }
        .mode-card.slow { border-color: var(--accent-orange); }
        .mode-card.knowledge { border-color: var(--accent-blue); }

        .mode-card .mode-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
        }

        .mode-card h3 {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .mode-card p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
        }

        .mode-card .token-label {
            display: inline-block;
            margin-top: 0.5rem;
            padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-family: monospace;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .mode-card.fast .token-label {
            background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
            color: var(--accent-green);
        }

        .mode-card.slow .token-label {
            background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15);
            color: var(--accent-orange);
        }

        .mode-card.knowledge .token-label {
            background: rgba(67, 97, 238, 0.15);
            color: var(--accent-blue);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4: KNOWSELF FRAMEWORK
           =========================================== */
        .framework-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .pipeline {
            display: flex;
            align-items: stretch;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            margin-top: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .pipeline-step {
            flex: 1;
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.75rem;
            position: relative;
        }

        .pipeline-step::after {
            content: '→';
            position: absolute;
            right: -0.75rem;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .pipeline-step:last-child::after {
            display: none;
        }

        .step-number {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            width: clamp(24px, 3vw, 32px);
            height: clamp(24px, 3vw, 32px);
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-cyan), var(--accent-blue));
            border-radius: 50%;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .pipeline-step h3 {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .pipeline-step p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
        }

        .pipeline-step .step-detail {
            margin-top: auto;
            padding: 0.5rem;
            background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.05);
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            font-family: monospace;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5: QUALITATIVE EXAMPLES
           =========================================== */
        .examples-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .examples-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            margin-top: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .example-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 12px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .example-header {
            padding: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        }

        .example-header h3 {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .example-header .task-badge {
            display: inline-block;
            margin-top: 0.25rem;
            padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-family: monospace;
        }

        .example-body {
            padding: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        .comparison-row {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.75rem;
            margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
        }

        .comparison-row:last-child {
            margin-bottom: 0;
        }

        .model-label {
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: clamp(70px, 12vw, 100px);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            padding-top: 0.1rem;
        }

        .model-label.knowself { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .model-label.fail { color: var(--accent-red); }

        .model-behavior {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .model-behavior.fail {
            color: var(--accent-red);
        }

        .model-behavior.success {
            color: var(--accent-green);
        }

        .reflection-note {
            margin-top: 0.75rem;
            padding: 0.5rem;
            background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.05);
            border-left: 2px solid var(--accent-cyan);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 6: ALFWORLD RESULTS TABLE
           =========================================== */
        .results-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--element-gap);
        }

        .results-table-container {
            overflow-x: auto;
            margin-top: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .results-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            min-width: 800px;
        }

        .results-table th,
        .results-table td {
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.75rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            text-align: center;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        }

        .results-table th {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
        }

        .results-table th.highlight {
            background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.1);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        .results-table td {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .results-table td.highlight {
            background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.08);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .results-table td.know-percent {
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .results-table tr.highlight-row td {
            background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.05);
        }

        .results-table .method-cell {
            text-align: left;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .results-table caption {
            text-align: left;
            padding: 0.5rem;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 7: EFFICIENCY CHART
           =========================================== */
        .efficiency-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .efficiency-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem);
            margin-top: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .chart-container {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
        }

        .chart-container h3 {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .bar-chart {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
        }

        .bar-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.75rem;
        }

        .bar-label {
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: clamp(60px, 10vw, 90px);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: right;
        }

        .bar-track {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(16px, 2.5vw, 24px);
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 4px;
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .bar-fill.knowself { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-cyan), #00cc99); }
        .bar-fill.full-knowledge { background: var(--accent-blue); }
        .bar-fill.baseline { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3); }

        .bar-value {
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: clamp(35px, 6vw, 50px);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .efficiency-highlight {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .efficiency-highlight h3 {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .stat-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: baseline;
            gap: 0.5rem;
        }

        .stat-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .stat-value.small {
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 3vw, 2rem);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .stat-label {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .stat-comparison {
            display: flex;
            gap: 1.5rem;
            margin-top: var(--element-gap);
        }

        .comparison-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
        }

        .comparison-dot {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            border-radius: 50%;
        }

        .comparison-dot.cyan { background: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .comparison-dot.blue { background: var(--accent-blue); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 8: TAKEAWAYS
           =========================================== */
        .takeaways-slide .slide-content {
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .takeaways-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.25rem);
            margin-top: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .takeaway-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            display: flex;
            gap: 1rem;
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        .takeaway-card:nth-child(2) { border-color: var(--accent-green); }
        .takeaway-card:nth-child(3) { border-color: var(--accent-orange); }
        .takeaway-card:nth-child(4) { border-color: var(--accent-magenta); }
        .takeaway-card:nth-child(5) { border-color: var(--accent-blue); }

        .takeaway-number {
            flex-shrink: 0;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            width: clamp(24px, 3vw, 32px);
            height: clamp(24px, 3vw, 32px);
            background: rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.15);
            border-radius: 50%;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        .takeaway-card:nth-child(2) .takeaway-number {
            background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
            color: var(--accent-green);
        }

        .takeaway-card:nth-child(3) .takeaway-number {
            background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15);
            color: var(--accent-orange);
        }

        .takeaway-card:nth-child(4) .takeaway-number {
            background: rgba(255, 0, 170, 0.15);
            color: var(--accent-magenta);
        }

        .takeaway-card:nth-child(5) .takeaway-number {
            background: rgba(67, 97, 238, 0.15);
            color: var(--accent-blue);
        }

        .takeaway-text h3 {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
        }

        .takeaway-text p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
        }

        .closing-slide {
            text-align: center;
        }

        .closing-slide .slide-content {
            align-items: center;
        }

        .closing-quote {
            max-width: 700px;
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 3vw, 2rem);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.4;
            font-style: italic;
        }

        .closing-quote::before {
            content: '"';
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        .closing-quote::after {
            content: '"';
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           RESPONSIVE BREAKPOINTS
           =========================================== */
        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.3rem, 4vw, 2rem);
            }
            .nav-dots { display: none; }
        }

        @media (max-width: 900px) {
            .problem-grid,
            .examples-grid,
            .efficiency-grid,
            .takeaways-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
            .pipeline {
                flex-direction: column;
            }
            .pipeline-step::after {
                content: '↓';
                right: 50%;
                top: auto;
                bottom: -0.75rem;
                transform: translateX(50%);
            }
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <!-- Progress Bar -->
    <div class="progress-bar" id="progressBar"></div>

    <!-- Navigation Dots -->
    <nav class="nav-dots" id="navDots"></nav>

    <!-- =========================================
         SLIDE 1: TITLE
         ========================================= -->
    <section class="slide title-slide grid-bg" id="slide-1">
        <div class="glow-orb glow-orb-1"></div>
        <div class="glow-orb glow-orb-2"></div>
        <div class="slide-content">
            <span class="tagline reveal">arXiv:2504.03553</span>
            <h1 class="reveal">KnowSelf</h1>
            <p class="subtitle reveal">Teaching LLM Agents When to Think, Reflect, or Seek Knowledge</p>
            <div class="accent-line reveal"></div>
            <p class="reveal" style="color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: var(--body-size); max-width: 600px;">
                Enabling agents to autonomously regulate knowledge utilization through situational self-awareness
            </p>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- =========================================
         SLIDE 2: PROBLEM - FLOOD IRRIGATION
         ========================================= -->
    <section class="slide problem-slide grid-bg" id="slide-2">
        <div class="glow-orb glow-orb-1"></div>
        <div class="slide-content">
            <h2 class="reveal">Current Agent Training Uses "Flood Irrigation"</h2>
            <p class="reveal" style="color: var(--text-secondary); max-width: 800px;">
                Existing approaches indiscriminately inject knowledge regardless of situational needs, leading to pattern collapse and high inference costs.
            </p>

            <div class="problem-grid">
                <div class="problem-card imitate reveal">
                    <span class="method-label">Trajectory Imitation</span>
                    <h3>ReAct</h3>
                    <p>Blindsly copies gold trajectories without situational evaluation. Fails on novel inputs.</p>

    <!-- =========================================
         JAVASCRIPT: SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
         ========================================= -->
    <script>
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.totalSlides = this.slides.length;
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.navDots = document.getElementById('navDots');

                this.init();
            }

            init() {
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();

                // Mark first slide as visible
                this.slides[0].classList.add('visible');
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const options = {
                    root: null,
                    rootMargin: '0px',
                    threshold: 0.5
                };

                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const slideIndex = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            this.currentSlide = slideIndex;
                            this.updateProgress();
                            this.updateNavDots();
                        }
                    });
                }, options);

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    switch(e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowDown':
                        case 'ArrowRight':
                        case ' ':
                        case 'PageDown':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.nextSlide();
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowUp':
                        case 'ArrowLeft':
                        case 'PageUp':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.prevSlide();
                            break;
                        case 'Home':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(0);
                            break;
                        case 'End':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.totalSlides - 1);
                            break;
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                let touchEndY = 0;

                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.changedTouches[0].screenY;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    touchEndY = e.changedTouches[0].screenY;
                    const diff = touchStartY - touchEndY;

                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        if (diff > 0) {
                            this.nextSlide();
                        } else {
                            this.prevSlide();
                        }
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.updateProgress();
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                this.navDots.innerHTML = '';
                for (let i = 0; i < this.totalSlides; i++) {
                    const dot = document.createElement('div');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    this.navDots.appendChild(dot);
                }
            }

            updateProgress() {
                const progress = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.totalSlides) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = progress + '%';
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                const dots = this.navDots.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
                dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }

            nextSlide() {
                if (this.currentSlide < this.totalSlides - 1) {
                    this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                }
            }

            prevSlide() {
                if (this.currentSlide > 0) {
                    this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                }
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }
        }

        // Initialize presentation
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            new SlidePresentation();
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
