    <!-- =========================================
         SLIDE 1: TITLE
         ========================================= -->
    <section class="slide title-slide grid-bg" id="slide-1">
        <div class="glow-orb glow-orb-1"></div>
        <div class="glow-orb glow-orb-2"></div>
        <div class="slide-content">
            <span class="tagline reveal">arXiv:2504.03553</span>
            <h1 class="reveal">KnowSelf</h1>
            <p class="subtitle reveal">Teaching LLM Agents When to Think, Reflect, or Seek Knowledge</p>
            <div class="accent-line reveal"></div>
            <p class="reveal" style="color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: var(--body-size); max-width: 600px;">
                Enabling agents to autonomously regulate knowledge utilization through situational self-awareness
            </p>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- =========================================
         SLIDE 2: PROBLEM - FLOOD IRRIGATION
         ========================================= -->
    <section class="slide problem-slide grid-bg" id="slide-2">
        <div class="glow-orb glow-orb-1"></div>
        <div class="slide-content">
            <h2 class="reveal">Current Agent Training Uses "Flood Irrigation"</h2>
            <p class="reveal" style="color: var(--text-secondary); max-width: 800px;">
                Existing approaches indiscriminately inject knowledge regardless of situational needs, leading to pattern collapse and high inference costs.
            </p>

            <div class="problem-grid">
                <div class="problem-card imitate reveal">
                    <span class="method-label">Trajectory Imitation</span>
                    <h3>ReAct</h3>
                    <p>Blindsly copies gold trajectories without situational evaluation. Fails on novel inputs.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="problem-card trial reveal">
                    <span class="method-label">Trial-and-Error</span>
                    <h3>Reflexion</h3>
                    <p>Relies on external feedback for every correction. Fragile to feedback quality.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="problem-card knowledge reveal">
                    <span class="method-label">Knowledge-Augmented</span>
                    <h3>KnowAgent, WKM</h3>
                    <p>100% knowledge injection at every step. Wasteful and suboptimal.</p>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="vs-divider reveal">
                <span class="vs-badge">VS</span>
            </div>

            <div class="solution-note reveal">
                <p>Humans possess situational self-awareness — the metacognitive ability to know when we need help.</p>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- =========================================
         SLIDE 3: THREE THINKING MODES
         ========================================= -->
    <section class="slide modes-slide grid-bg" id="slide-3">
        <div class="slide-content">
            <h2 class="reveal">Three Situational Thinking Modes</h2>
            <p class="reveal" style="color: var(--text-secondary); max-width: 700px;">
                KnowSelf identifies three cognitive situations based on the agent's ability at each decision step.
            </p>

            <div class="tree-outcomes">
                <div class="mode-card fast reveal">
                    <div class="mode-icon">⚡</div>
                    <h3>Fast Thinking</h3>
                    <p>Agent directly produces the correct action with minimal deliberation.</p>
                    <span class="token-label">[FAST]</span>
                </div>
                <div class="mode-card slow reveal">
                    <div class="mode-icon">🔄</div>
                    <h3>Slow Thinking</h3>
                    <p>Agent initially produces incorrect action but self-corrects through reflection.</p>
                    <span class="token-label">[REFLECT]</span>
                </div>
                <div class="mode-card knowledge reveal">
                    <div class="mode-icon">📚</div>
                    <h3>Knowledgeable Thinking</h3>
                    <p>Agent cannot produce correct action even after reflection. Must consult external knowledge.</p>
                    <span class="token-label">[KNOW]</span>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="decision-tree reveal">
                <div class="tree-start">🤔 Can agent produce correct action?</div>
                <div class="tree-branch">
                    <div class="tree-question">
                        <span class="tree-yes">Yes</span>
                        <span class="tree-arrow">→</span>
                        <span class="question-text">Correct on first try?</span>
                        <div style="display: flex; gap: 0.5rem;">
                            <span class="tree-yes">Yes</span>
                            <span class="tree-no">No</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="tree-question">
                        <span class="tree-no">No</span>
                        <span class="tree-arrow">→</span>
                        <span class="question-text">Reflection helps?</span>
                        <div style="display: flex; gap: 0.5rem;">
                            <span class="tree-yes">Yes</span>
                            <span class="tree-no">No</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- =========================================
         SLIDE 4: KNOWSELF FRAMEWORK
         ========================================= -->
    <section class="slide framework-slide grid-bg" id="slide-4">
        <div class="glow-orb glow-orb-2"></div>
        <div class="slide-content">
            <h2 class="reveal">KnowSelf Framework</h2>
            <p class="reveal" style="color: var(--text-secondary); max-width: 700px;">
                A three-stage pipeline: Data Construction → Two-Stage Training → Self-Aware Inference
            </p>

            <div class="pipeline">
                <div class="pipeline-step reveal">
                    <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem;">
                        <span class="step-number">1</span>
                        <h3>Data Construction</h3>
                    </div>
                    <p>Agent self-explores environments. Heuristic criteria classify each step:</p>
                    <ul style="font-size: var(--small-size); color: var(--text-secondary); margin: 0.5rem 0 0.5rem 1.2rem;">
                        <li>Action matches gold → Fast</li>
                        <li>Reflection fixes it → Slow</li>
                        <li>Neither works → Knowledge</li>
                    </ul>
                    <div class="step-detail">[FAST], [REFLECT], [KNOW] tokens inserted</div>
                </div>

                <div class="pipeline-step reveal">
                    <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem;">
                        <span class="step-number">2</span>
                        <h3>Two-Stage Training</h3>
                    </div>
                    <p>Sequential fine-tuning approach:</p>
                    <ul style="font-size: var(--small-size); color: var(--text-secondary); margin: 0.5rem 0 0.5rem 1.2rem;">
                        <li><strong>SFT</strong> — Supervised fine-tuning for initial self-awareness</li>
                        <li><strong>RPO</strong> — Reward-based Policy Optimization refines token generation</li>
                    </ul>
                    <div class="step-detail">SFT → RPO pipeline</div>
                </div>

                <div class="pipeline-step reveal">
                    <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem;">
                        <span class="step-number">3</span>
                        <h3>Self-Aware Inference</h3>
                    </div>
                    <p>At deployment, special tokens trigger:</p>
                    <ul style="font-size: var(--small-size); color: var(--text-secondary); margin: 0.5rem 0 0.5rem 1.2rem;">
                        <li>Direct action execution</li>
                        <li>Reflection cycle</li>
                        <li>Knowledge base retrieval</li>
                    </ul>
                    <div class="step-detail">Autonomous cognitive resource regulation</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

         JAVASCRIPT: SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER

    <script>
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.totalSlides = this.slides.length;
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.navDots = document.getElementById('navDots');

                this.init();
            }

            init() {
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();

                // Mark first slide as visible
                this.slides[0].classList.add('visible');
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const options = {
                    root: null,
                    rootMargin: '0px',
                    threshold: 0.5
                };

                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const slideIndex = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            this.currentSlide = slideIndex;
                            this.updateProgress();
                            this.updateNavDots();
                        }
                    });
                }, options);

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    switch(e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowDown':
                        case 'ArrowRight':
                        case ' ':
                        case 'PageDown':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.nextSlide();
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowUp':
                        case 'ArrowLeft':
                        case 'PageUp':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.prevSlide();
                            break;
                        case 'Home':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(0);
                            break;
                        case 'End':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.totalSlides - 1);
                            break;
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                let touchEndY = 0;

                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.changedTouches[0].screenY;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    touchEndY = e.changedTouches[0].screenY;
                    const diff = touchStartY - touchEndY;

                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        if (diff > 0) {
                            this.nextSlide();
                        } else {
                            this.prevSlide();
                        }
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.updateProgress();
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                this.navDots.innerHTML = '';
                for (let i = 0; i < this.totalSlides; i++) {
                    const dot = document.createElement('div');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    this.navDots.appendChild(dot);
                }
            }

            updateProgress() {
                const progress = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.totalSlides) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = progress + '%';
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                const dots = this.navDots.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
                dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }

            nextSlide() {
                if (this.currentSlide < this.totalSlides - 1) {
                    this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                }
            }

            prevSlide() {
                if (this.currentSlide > 0) {
                    this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                }
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }
        }

        // Initialize presentation
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            new SlidePresentation();
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
